install_output_empty: Kute umphumela okwamanje. Imigca yetheminali kusuka ethuluzini lekufaka itawuvela lapha.
linux_setup_title: Linux Kukhanya & SP Kukhanya Ithuluzi Kusetha
linux_setup_welcome_desc: Kulandza nekulungisa injini lekhanyako ngesivinini lesikhulu kute ukhone kubuyisela nekuvuselela umdlali wakho ngaphandle kwemzamo.
linux_card_engine_desc: MediaTek imdzabu flashing ithuluzi ngekuhambisana umtapo jikelele staged.
linux_card_usb_desc: Iniketa imvume yedeskithophu yekukhulumisana nemdlali kumodi ye-Bootloader.
system_checker_title: SP Flash Ithuluzi Luhlelo Hlola & Kuhlola
system_checker_desc: Kucinisekisa lokuphelele kwebashayeli, emamojuli e-kernel, timvume, kanye nemitapho yesikhatsi sekusebenta kucinisekisa kukhanya lokutsembekile.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Utfola ngcondvomshini wakho ulungele kuxhumana nemdlali wakho kute utfole tibuyeketo tesoftware.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Ihlola kusetha kwe-Linux lokusezingeni lelisetulu kwe-SP Flash Tool, kufinyelela kwe-USB, timvume te-serial, kanye netincenye teluhlelo.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Utfola ngcondvomshini wakho ulungele kuxhumana nemdlali wakho bese ufaka tibuyeketo tesoftware ngekwetsembeka.
settings_checker_desc: Utfola ngcondvomshini wakho ulungele kuxhumana nemdlali wakho bese ufaka tibuyeketo tesoftware ngekwetsembeka.
linux_prep_ready_friendly: Ikhompyutha yakho ilungele kuxhumana nemdlali wakho.
linux_prep_blocked: Lekhompyutha ayikhoni kusebentisa Lithuluzi le-SP Flash.
linux_prep_fix_body: Iphasiwedi yakho iyadzingeka kanye kute usethe lekhompyutha kutsi ikhanye: imitsetfo ye-USB yemadivayisi e-MediaTek kanye nekufinyelela kwe-serial port.
linux_prep_fix_body_wizard: Kusetha lekhompyutha ye-SP Flash Tool, iphasiwedi yakho itawudzingeka esinyatselweni lesilandzelako sekucubungula imitsetfo ye-USB bese wengeta i-akhawunti yakho emacenjini ladzingekako emsebentisi we-serial. Uma ungavumi, lesicelo sitawuvalwa.
linux_prep_fixed: Kufinyelela kuniketwe, Lithuluzi le-SP Flash lilungile.
linux_prep_reboot_body: Kusetha sekuphelile futsi i-akhawunti yakho yengetiwe emacenjini lasetjentiswako ladzingeka e-SP Flash Tool. Sicela uvule kabusha ngcondvomshini wakho kute timvume letinsha tisebente, bese uphindze uvule i-app. Chafata luphawu lwekuhlola kute uvale luhlelo lokusebenta nyalo.
linux_prep_reboot_done_btn: Kwentiwe, Vala i-app kute ucale kabusha ikhompyutha
settings_driver_desc: Ngaphambi kwekutsi usebentise le-app kwekucala, kufanele ufake umshayeli we-MediaTek USB, bese ucala kabusha ngcondvomshini wakho.
home_desc: Tfola i-firmware ku-inthanethi nobe ukhetse iphakheji yasendzaweni, bese uyayi-flash kudivayisi yakho.
sel_source_desc: Landza i-firmware ku-inthanethi, noma ungenise iphakheji yasendzaweni.
settings_advanced_desc: Ukhombisa indlela yekufaka, imodi yekufaka kanye netihlungi tekukhipha.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_guided_install_desc: Le-app ihlala nawe ngekucisha, kuxhuma, kanye nekufaka.
settings_sp_gui_desc: Ivala i-Updater bese ivula i-SP Flash Tool GUI ngefayela lekusakateka le-firmware lelikhetsiwe kanye netitfombe tekuhlukanisa letilayishiwe ngaphambilini.
settings_terminal_desc: Igijima kufakwa kwesoftware yakho ku-Terminal kute ubone lwati lwebuchwepheshe ngenchubekelembili.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Igijima kufakwa kwesofthiwe yakho ku-Command Prompt kute ubone lwati lwebuchwepheshe ngenchubekelembili.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Kukhetsa ngekutsandza. Letinye tintfo letihlosiwe te-MediaTek tiyala kukhanya kuze kube ngulapho i-SP Flash Tool iniketwa ifayela lekucinisekisa (.auth); engeza yakho lapha uma ngabe idivayisi idinga.
terminal_install_no_scatter: Kute ifayela lekusakateka lelitfolakele kulephakheji, ngako-ke kute umyalo we-console longakhiwa.
terminal_install_no_tool: Kute SP Flash Tool kwakha noma MTKClient iphuzu lokungena etholakalayo lendlela.
terminal_install_failed: Ayikhoni kuvula lifasitelo letheminali. Umyalo wekufaka wabhalwa ku {path}.
status_terminal_install: Faka umyalo lovulekile efasitelweni lakho lesiphelo ({path}).
terminal_install_prompt_body:
{terminal_name} manje kutawuvulwa kugijima {method}.

• Uma ingakacimi, cisha {device} yakho.
• Uma ngabe ixhunywe ku-USB, yikhiphe kucala.
{hint}
• Xhuma idivayisi yakho kukhompyutha yakho uma lifasitelo {terminal_name} selivulekile.

Chafata Kulungile kute wetfule bese uphuma ku-Updater.
terminal_hint_innioasis: • Lusito: Nangabe le- device ingaxhumani ngekuzenzakalela, cindezela ngebumnene inkinobho yekusetha kabusha emgodzini we- pin nge- paperclip ngesikhatsi uxhuma intsambo ye- USB.
terminal_hint_generic: • Lusito: Faka idivayisi yakho kumodi yekulandza i-firmware (yehluka ngekuya ngemodeli: sibonelo, susa ibhethri bese uyigcina ingaphandle ngekhebula le-USB lexhunyiwe, nobe ucishe emandla ngebhethri, nobe ubambe i-Volume Down/Up ngesikhatsi uxhume i-USB).
sp_gui_install_prompt_body:
SP Flash Ithuluzi GUI manje utawuvulwa nge-firmware yakho ilayishiwe ngaphambilini.

• Ku-SP Flash Tool, khetsa "Landa" ebhokisini leliwela phansi.
• Chafata inkinobho letsi "Landa".
• Ciniseka kutsi {device} yakho icishiwe futsi ayixhunyiwe.
{hint}
• Xhuma intsambo ye-USB kukhompyutha yakho ngemuva kwekuchafata Download.

Chafata Kulungile kute wetfule Lithuluzi le-SP Flash bese uphuma ku-Updater.
settings_install_themes_desc: Uma inikwe emandla, tindikimba te-Rockbox tidluliselwa ngekuzenzakalela ku-Y1 na-Y2 ngemuva kwekufakwa kwe-Rockbox ngemphumelelo.
themes_placement_failed_note: Asikwatanga kubeka iphakheji yetingcikitsi kumdlali wakho. Ungaphindze uzame kusuka ku- Settings.
settings_filter_original_pre307: Khombisa kukhishwa kweSoftware Yekucala lendzala kune-3.0.7
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Kukhishwa kweSoftware yekucala lendzala kune-3.0.7 akuhambisani nemayunithi e-Y1 latsengiswa ne-Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Kukhanyisa kwakha lokudzala kulamayunithi kutawuvimbela kutsi angavuli kuze kube ngulapho kuphindze kufakwe inguqulo lensha.

Ucinisekile yini kutsi ufuna kukhombisa kukhishwa kweSoftware Yekucala lendzala kune-3.0.7?
settings_240p_tip: Ukhombisa kwakha kutsi i-ROM zip yakhe iyinhlobo ye-240p (rom ... _240p.zip). 240p yakha ayihambisani nemayunithi e-Y1 ku-Innioasis OS ngephansi kwe-3.0.7, ngako-ke Khombisa I-Rockbox Lendzala Yakha inikwe emandla ngayo.
settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Kukhishwa kwe Rockbox-Y1 ngaphambi kwa 0.5 akuhambisani nemayunithi e Y1 latsengiswa ngemuva kwa Mashi 2026 nge Innioasis OS 3.0.7 lefakwe ngaphambilini.

Kukhanyisa kwakha lokudzala kulamadivayisi kutawuvimbela kuqalisa.

Ucinisekile kutsi ufuna kukhombisa ema-Rockbox lamadzala lakhako?
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Sicela ukhetse .zip, .rar archive, noma ifayela lekusakata (*scatter*.txt) ngekhatsi kwefolda yeluhlelokusebenta kute ufake luhlelokusebenta lolukhetsile ku {target} yakho.
sel_offline: Tintfo letibhalwe ku-inthanethi atitfolakali nyalo. Sebentisa lifayela lendzawo, nobe uhlole kuxhumana kwakho.
rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
sel_multiple_scatters_error: Emaphakheji lamanyenti e-firmware noma emafayela lasakatekile atfolakala kulefolda/kulondvolota. Ucelwa kutsi ukhetse ifolda noma i-archive lecuketse iphakheji yinye kuphela ye-firmware ngesikhatsi sinye.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Lokukhululwa kucuketse emafayela ekusakateka langetulu kwalinye, ngako-ke i-Updater ayikhoni kutjela kutsi nguyiphi indlela umdlali wakho layidzingako. Umsunguli we {software} bekutawudzingeka kutsi avuselele kukhishwa kwabo kwe-firmware kute afake kuphela ifayela linye lekusakateka.
sp_search_restart: Kute idivayisi okwamanje, kuseshwa futsi (umzamo {count}). Gcina umdlali acishiwe bese uyawuxhuma uma ucelwa.
sp_auth_missing_file: Ifayela lekucinisekisa alitfolakali ({path}); kukhanya ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_missing_platform: Ifayela lekusakateka alimemeteli iplatifomu yalo, ngako-ke kucushwa kwekhonsoli yefayela lekucinisekisa akuzange kwakhiwe; kukhanya ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_missing_storage: Ifayela lekusakateka alimemeteli luhlobo lwesitoreji (EMMC / NAND / UFS), ngako-ke kucushwa kwekhonsoli yefayela lekucinisekisa akuzange kwakhiwe; kukhanya ngaphandle kwayo.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Kute lifayela lekucinisekisa leliniketwe; kukhanya ngaphandle kwalomunye.
sp_config_write_failed: Akazange akhone kubhala ifayela lekucushwa kwekhonsoli; kukhanya ngaphandle kwefayela lekucinisekisa.
settings_notifications_desc: Khombisa tatiso teluhlelo lwesatiso kanye netinhlobo tekuvuselela letingezansi. Off ugcina konkhe lokungekhatsi kwe-app.
settings_notifications_background_btn: Nika emandla tatiso uma i-app ivaliwe
settings_add_device_type_hint: Luhlobo kubuyeketwa kwe-hardware yemdlali. Abadlali bemodeli lefanako bangakhiwa ngekubuyeketwa lokungetulu kwalinye — sibonelo Luhlobo A neLuhlobo B — futsi isoftware yentiwa kulomunye wabo. Hlola sitika ngemuva kwemdlali; uma ingasho luhlobo, shiya kukhetsa kwekucala.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Gcina luhlelo lokusebenta ebha yemenyu ngemuva kwekuvalwa kwelifasitelo, ngako-ke usatfola tatiso tekuvuselela luhlelo lokusebenta kanye ne-firmware yemdlali. Off: kuvala lifasitelo kuyekela luhlelo lokusebenta.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Gcina luhlelo lokusebenta ethreyini yeluhlelo ngemuva kwekuvalwa kwelifasitelo, ngako-ke usatfola tatiso tekuvuselela luhlelo lokusebenta kanye ne-firmware yemdlali. Off: kuvala lifasitelo kuyekela luhlelo lokusebenta.
settings_offline_mode_desc: Fihla ikhathalogu yemmango leku-inthanethi bese ufaka isoftware kusuka kumafayela endzawo kuphela.
sel_themepack_prompt_body: Ukhanyise ukwakha kwe-Rockbox ye-360p. Ungatsandza yini kufaka i-360p Theme Pack kuledivayisi nyalo?
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Sicela unciphise i-USB, uvule emandla bese uvula ku-Rockbox kanye (ngako-ke icala ifolda yayo lengekhatsi yeluhlelo lwe-.rockbox), bese uphindze uxhume i-USB bese ukhetsa 'Imodi Yekugcina i-USB'.

Uma sewuxhunyiwe, chafata Chubeka kute ukhetse noma nguyiphi ifolda kumdlali wakho.
sel_themepack_select_folder: Khetsa noma nguyiphi ifolda kusitoreji semdlali wakho loxhunyiwe
sel_themepack_success: Iphakheji Yengcikitsi Ye-Rockbox ifakwe ngemphumelelo kudivayisi yakho!
sel_only_local: Khetsa iphakheji ye-firmware yendzawo ye-.zip nobe ye-.rar, nobe ifayela le-.txt lefolda / scatter, lekufakwa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, kute i-inthanethi ledzingekako. Isebenta ngawo wonkhe umdlali we-Innioasis kanye ne-Timmkoo umsindvo.
sel_only_local_generic: Khetsa iphakheji ye-firmware yendzawo (.zip, .rar) noma ifolda lenefayela lekusakateka lekufakwa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, isebenta nemadivayisi e-MediaTek lajwayelekile.
sel_offline_install: Faka i-firmware kusuka kufayela le-.zip nobe le-.rar kunobe ngumuphi umdlali wemsindvo we-Innioasis nobe we-Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Faka i-firmware kusuka ku-archive ye-.zip/.rar noma kufolda ye-firmware kumadivayisi e-MediaTek lajwayelekile.
sel_update_available: Kukhona update ku {software} lekhona ku {model} yakho.
conn_offline: Awukho ku-inthanethi. Kufakwa kusuka ku-Archive ye-Firmware yeMmango akutfolakali.
conn_archive_unavailable: Ikhathalogu ye-firmware ayifinyeleleki kwesikhashana. Usengafaka kusuka ku-archive noma emafayela endzawo.
single_instance_body: Lenye ikhophi ivulekile, noma isasebenta ngemuva. Emakhophi lamabili bekatawuncintisana ngekuxhumana kwe-USB yemdlali, ngako-ke lena ngeke icale.
single_instance_focus_failed: Ikhophi egijimako ayizange iphendvule sicelo sekukhombisa lifasitelo layo. Kungenteka kutsi limatasatasa nobe lilengiswe. Kuphocelela kuyiyekela kutawuphazamisa noma yini lekufakako.
single_instance_force_failed: Ikhophi lehambako ayikwatanga kupheliswa. Yekela wena, bese ucala i-updater futsi.
single_instance_busy_body: Ikhophi lesebentako ifaka isoftware nobe ikhuluma nemdlali, ngako-ke kuyicedza nyalo bekungaphazamisa loko. Lokwetfulwa kutawuvalwa; sebentisa lifasitelo lelikhona nobe sithonjana sayo semenyu uma kufaka sekuphelile.
notices_summary_body: Vula Titatiso ku- app kute utifundze.
toast_battery_charged: Ngaphambi kwekutsi usebentise loku kumdlali wakho, shaja ibhethri lokungenani li-awa .
toast_battery_charged_device: Ngaphambi kwekutsi usebentise loku kudivayisi yakho, shaja ibhethri lokungenani li-awa .
toast_background_notifications_menu_bar: Nika emandla tatiso tangemuva kute utfole tibuyeketo futsi ukhiphe tecwayiso ngisho noma i-Updater ivaliwe kubha yemenyu.
toast_background_notifications_system_tr: Nika emandla tatiso tangemuva kute utfole kuvuselelwa futsi ukhiphe tecwayiso ngisho noma i-Updater ivaliwe ku-system tray.
translate_unavailable_notice_body: Tinsita tekuhumusha letiku-inthanethi njengamanje atifinyeleleki noma tise-cooldown. Emanothi ekukhishwa ekucala atawukhonjiswa esikhundleni saloko.
translate_unavailable_hint: Kuhumusha akutfolakali kwesikhashana. Hlola kuchumana kwakho ne-inthanethi nobe uphindze uzame ngemuva kwesikhatsi.
sel_notes_hint: Khetsa kukhishwa kute ubuke luhlu lwayo lwetingucuko
flash_wait_desc: Cisha idivayisi kucala. Nangabe ixhunyiwe kodvwa ingabonakali, zama intsambo ye-USB nobe i-port lehlukile.
dialog_pre_install_header: Sicela wente siciniseko kutsi {model} yakho icishiwe futsi ayixhunyiwe nge-USB
dialog_pre_install_innioasis_tip:
• Cisha ngalokuphelele idivayisi yakho ngaphambi kwekutsi ucale.
• Nangabe le-device ifriziwe nobe ingaphendvuli, sebentisa i-pin nobe i-paperclip emgodzini wekusetha kabusha kute uphocelele kutsi amandla acinywe abe yimodi yekulandza.
• Gcina intsambo ye-USB ingaxhunyiwe kwanyalo.
• Chafata ku- Continue, bese uxhuma idivayisi yakho nge- USB uma ucelwa.
dialog_pre_install_generic_tip:
• Cisha ngalokuphelele idivayisi yakho ye-MediaTek.
• Gcina intsambo ye-USB ingaxhunyiwe kwanyalo.
• Kuya ngemodeli, zama kuxhuma ngebhethri lefakwe noma ngaphandle kwayo (noma ubambe iVolume Down / Up ngesikhatsi uxhuma).
• Chafata Continue, bese uxhuma intsambo ye-USB uma ucelwa.
sel_keep_data_incompatible: Angeke sikhone kugcina idatha yakho yalokufakwa ngoba i-firmware yakho yamanje ayihambisani ne-Keep Data.
flash_paperclip_explanation: Khupha intsambo ye-USB bese usebentisa i-paperclip nobe i-pin kute ucindetele inkinobho yekusetha kabusha, bese uzama kuphindze uxhume.
flash_hint_wall_charger: • Kunconywa kutsi uxhume umdlali kushaja yelubondza imizuzu lengu-30 kuya elihoreni ngaphambi kwekutsi uzame kuxhuma.
flash_hint_install_drivers: • Uma ngabe use-Windows, ciniseka kutsi ufake Bashayeli.
flash_hint_windows_reboot_driver: • Ema-PC e-Windows kufanele acalwe kabusha ngemuva kwekufaka umshayeli ngaphambi kwekutsi asetjentiswe kwekucala.
keep_data_running_fmt_no_name: Ingabe le software seyivele ifakwe ku {model} yakho?
install_first_which_firmware: Nguyiphi isoftware lesebenta ku {model} yakho njengamanje?
install_first_which_firmware_hint: Nangabe ungaciniseki, khetsa 'Lokunye' nobe i-software locabanga kutsi ifakiwe.
install_first_prerequisite_hint: Kuchubeka ngalokufaka, sicela ucinisekise kutsi {model} yakho seyivele isebentisa isoftware ledzingekako yesisekelo ({software}).
keep_data_only_compatible_hint: Singagcina emasethingi akho kanye nemidiya kuphela nangabe umdlali vele asebentisa le-software nobe inguqulo lehambisanako.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_y1: Singagcina emasethingi akho kuphela nangabe umdlali vele asebentisa le-software nobe inguqulo lehambisanako.
keep_data_only_compatible_hint_other: Singagcina emasethingi akho kanye nemidiya kuphela nangabe umdlali vele asebentisa le-software nobe inguqulo lehambisanako.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Vumela Gcina Tilungiselelo Nemidiya kunoma nguyiphi i-firmware lefakwe
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Yeqa umbuto wekuhambisana. Sebentisa loku kuphela uma uciniseka kutsi umdlali utawuchubeka asebenta ngetilungiselelo takhe tanyalo kanye nemidiya.
err_keep_data_failed: Ayikhoni kugcina emasethingi akho kanye nemidiya: ifolda ye-firmware ayibhaleki. Kute lokufakwe.
flash_keep_data_tooltip: Igcina emasethingi akho kanye nemidiya kumdlali. Lokusele kwesoftware kufakwa njengenjwayelo.
flash_keep_data_warning: Uma uchubeka ngaphandle kwaloku, emasethingi akho kanye nemidiya kutawusethwa kabusha esitoreji sangekhatsi semdlali.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox_y1: Uma uchubeka ngaphandle kwaloku, tindikimba takho te-Rockbox, emafonti kanye netilungiselelo titawususwa. Umculo wakho kanye naletinye tindlela tekusakata titawuhlala kumdlali.
flash_keep_data_warning_rockbox: Uma uchubeka ngaphandle kwaloku, tindikimba takho te-Rockbox, emafonti kanye netilungiselelo titawususwa, futsi sitoreji sangekhatsi semdlali sitawusethwa kabusha.
flash_keep_data_warning_y1: Uma uchubeka ngaphandle kwaloku, emasethingi akho atawusethwa kabusha. Umculo wakho kanye naletinye tindlela tekusakata titawuhlala kumdlali.
format_all_data_warning_y1: Le-firmware kumele ifomethe kabusha sitoreji sangekhatsi semdlali. Emasethingi lagciniwe atawususwa; umculo wakho kanye naletinye tindlela tekusakata titawuhlala tikhona.
format_all_data_warning_other: Le-firmware kumele ifomethe kabusha sitoreji sangekhatsi semdlali. Tilungiselelo letigciniwe kanye nemidiya legcinwe esitoreji lesakhelwe ngaphakathi kutawususwa. Imidiya ku-microSD yakho ihlala endaweni.
format_all_confirm_question: Fometha kabusha sitoreji sangekhatsi ku {model} yakho?
format_all_confirm_body:
Ku {software} sidzinga kufometha kabusha sitoreji sakho sangekhatsi se {model} ngaphambi kwekutsi sichubeke. Ngemuva kwaloko kutawuzanywa lomunye umzamo we-SP Flash Tool, kepha ku-Fomat Konkhe + Layisha imodi ngekugijima kwe-XML console-mode.

{data_effect}
format_all_recovery: Khupha i-USB, bese ufaka i-paperclip nobe i-pin ku-pinhole yekusetha kabusha ku-{model} yakho. Chafata Lokulandzelako kute uphindze uzame kumodi yeFometha Konkhe + Layisha.
err_pmt_format_required_desc: SP Flash Tool wabika kutsi ithebula lokuhlukanisa umdlali washintshela (8502). Le-firmware kufanele ifakwe ku-Fomat Konkhe + Layisha imodi, lefometha kabusha sitoreji sangekhatsi.
install_first_hint: Ngaphambi kwekutsi usethe {target} kwekucala, {model} yakho idzinga kutsi igijime {software} — noma {target} yona, uma ngabe seyifakiwe futsi isebenta.
install_first_version_fmt: Ingabe {model} yakho seyivele ihlangabetana nesidzingo se {software} ({version})?
install_first_power_on_fmt: Sicela unciphise i-USB, uvule {model} yakho bese uchafata Lokulandzelako.
install_first_power_on_hint: Vumela umdlali acale kanye ku-firmware lesisekelo, bese uyayicisha kuze ufake lokulandzelako.
install_first_need_body: {target} isebenta kahle kakhulu uma ucala nge {software} ku ​​{model} yakho. Sitawufaka {software} kucala, bese siyachubeka ku {target} ngekuzenzakalela.
install_first_when_body: {target} akukafaneli ifakwe ngco ngetulu kwa {running}: ku {model} yakho umdlali angeke acale kahle ngemuva kwaloko. Kufaka {software} kucala ngumzila lophephile, bese {target} bese uyalandzela ngekuzenzakalela.

SP Flash Ithuluzi GUI manje utawetfula.

• Uma ingakacimi, cisha idivayisi yakho.
• Uma ngabe ixhunywe ku-USB, yikhiphe kucala.

support_story_1_lead: Kuvikela idivayisi yakho eticupheni te-hardware letithulile kanye nekubuyeketwa lokuphukile.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis njalo ukhipha ema-firmware lamasha ebadlali labafana ne-Y1 (kuhloswe nekubuyeketwa kwebhodi lefihlekile njenge-6.0, 7.0, na-8.0) lephula buthule emadivayisi lamadzala. Lokubi kakhulu, iwebhusayithi yabo iniketa tecwayiso letite kanye nekufinyelela lokute kuma-firmware lasebenta ngaphambilini kute alulame esimeni lesinetitini. Updater kanye nephrojekthi ye-Community Firmware batsatsa tincetu: sigcina yonkhe i-ROM yesitoko sefa, sicinisekisa ngekuzenzakalela kubuyeketwa kwe-hardware yakho, futsi sigcine umdlali wakho asebenta ngendlela lephephile.
support_story_1_item_1: Kukhulula Badlali Labephukile: Kuhlolwa kwekuphepha kucinisekisa kutsi tibuyeketo letinsha atize tibhidlite i-hardware lendzala.
support_story_1_item_2: Ema-ROM Esitokwe Lagciniwe: Kugcogcwa lokuphelele kwema-firmware asefekthri ekucala Innioasis isusiwe.
support_story_1_item_3: Ipulatifomu Yesiphambano Yemdzabu: Emathulusi lakhanyako lagcwele e-macOS, Linux, ne-Windows ngekufana.
support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: Kutfolakala kwebhodi lokuzenzakalelayo ngako-ke uhlale utfola iphakheji lefanele.
support_story_2_headline: Kute emaDrayivu e-Google laphukile. Kute umsebenti wekucagela. Kusebenta nje kwe-firmware.
support_story_2_lead: Sakhiwonchanti semmango lesinesivinini lesikhulu, lesicinisekisiwe longancika kuso mbamba.
support_story_2_body: Kulandzela phansi isoftware lesemtsetfweni ye-Innioasis kuvame kusho kuhlanta emaforamu etikhonjiso te-Google Drayivu letiphelelwe sikhatsi, emasheya e-Baidu cloud lafile, kanye nemafayela e-zip layimfihlakalo langanamathuluzi lakhanyako. Sakha inethiwekhi yekulandza letsembekile, letimele lenebucotfo be-SHA-256 lobucinisekisiwe, tatiso tekuvuselela, kanye nekufakwa lokucondziswa sinyatselo ngesinyatselo. Iminikelo yakho igcina ngalokucondzile lokulandvwako kanye nekubamba lokwenta loku kwenteke emahora langu-24 ngelilanga, emalanga langu-365 ngemnyaka.
support_story_2_item_1: I-CDN Lesheshako Lecondzile: Kulandzela lokusheshako, lokucondzile lokute imikhawulo yekulandza nobe tikhonjiso letifile.
support_story_2_item_2: Vuselela Titfunywa: Tfola tecwayiso ngesikhatsi kukhishwa lokusha kwemmango noma kulungiswa kwehla.
support_story_2_item_3: Kufaka Ngesinyatselo Ngesinyatselo Lokucondzisiwe: Tikhutsato letibonakalako leticacile tikuhamba ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi ngekucindzetela inkinobho.
support_story_2_item_4: Ummango Lokhuluma Tilwimi Letinyenti: Ubhalwe ngalokuphelele ngesiNgisi, ngesiShayina, ngesiJalimane, ngesiSpanishi, ngesiFulentshi & ngesiJapan.
support_story_3_headline: Kuvula emandla laphelele emdlali wakho we-Innioasis.
support_story_3_lead: Kuletsa iRockbox, tinhlelo tekusebenta letilula letikhetsekile, kanye nenkhululeko ye-audiophile.
support_story_3_body: Isofthiwe yefektri yesitoko iklwebha kuphela ebusweni baloko i-hardware yakho ye-Y1 noma ye-Y2 lengakwenta. Ummango wetfu waletsa iRockbox, tinhlelo tekusebenta letilula letikhetsekile, kudlala kwe-audiophile codec, kanye netingcikitsi letikhetsekile ekuphileni. Sitsenga kwehlukahlukana kwe-hardware lebonakalako ngaphandle kwesikhwama kute sivivinye, sibuyisele emuva, futsi sicinisekise konkhe kufaka. Kusekela i-Updater kusekela ngalokucondzile lamayunithi ekuhlolwa futsi kusheshisa kutfutfukiswa kwe-firmware yesiko.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox Ngekuchafata Kanye: Kudlala kwe-Audiophile kanye netingcikitsi letikhetsekile letifakwe ngemizuzwana.
support_story_3_item_2: I-Firmware Yemmango: Kutfutfukiswa kwebhethri, i-UI lehlantekile, kanye nekwesekelwa kwe-codec yemsindvo yesimanje.
support_story_3_item_3: Lab Ye-Hardware Lesebentako: Sihlola kumadivayisi labonakalako mbamba ngaphambi kwekukhipha noma ngukuphi kwakha.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% yamahhala, isoftware yekucala yebumfihlo ngaphandle kwetikhangiso noma kulandzelela.
support_story_4_lead: Kulondvolotwa kwe-firmware leniketwa emandla ngummango kugcina emadivayisi akho angafiki etindzaweni tekulahla imfucuza.
support_story_4_body: Uma inkampani ye-hardware idlulela ku-gadget yabo lelandzelako, timodeli letindzala tiyalahlwa. Innioasis ayiniketi kusekelwa kwe-Linux, kute ema-changelogs lasobala, futsi kute indlela lemelula yekululama uma kufakwa kwehluleka. Updater ikhona ngoba basebentisi labanenshisekelo akukafaneli kutsi balahle umdlali wemculo lophelele. 100% weminikelo yemmango iya ngco ekugcineni lelithuluzi livulekele wonkhe umuntfu.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Kululama lokufakazelwe kugeleta ngisho noma emadivayisi ala kuqalisa.
support_story_4_item_2: Linux Kusekela Kwekucala: Kusekelwa ngalokuphelele kweMediaTek kukhanya kuma-Linux distros.
support_story_4_item_3: Ema-Changelogs Lasobala: Emanothi ekukhishwa lanemininingwane kute wati kahle kutsi ngutiphi tingucuko.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Imali Yemmango: Njalo likhofi ligcina i-archive ivulekile futsi imahhala kubo bonkhe.
support_methods_subtitle: Khetsa indlela loyitsandzako yekunikela. Wonkhe umnikelo ukhokhela ngco kulandvwa, kubamba, kanye nekuhlola i-hardware.

update_install_linux: Landa i {hint}, yenta kutsi isebente, bese uyayigijima, itsatsa sikhundla senguqulo yangaphambilini.
update_install_generic: Landa i-{hint} ekhasini lekukhishwa bese ulandzela ticondziso tekufaka teluhlelo lwakho.
update_check_failed: Ayikhoni kuhlola kutsi kukhona yini lokusha nyalo. Hlola kuxhumana kwakho bese uyazama futsi.

settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Khombisa imininingwane lelula yekucedza ngaphandle kwekucela iminikelo ngemuva kwekukhanya.

retry_guidance_step_3: 3. Faka intsambo ye-USB emuva, bese uyazama futsi.

linux_engine_staged_desc: MediaTek SP Lithuluzi Flash esigabeni ngekuhambisana libpng12.
linux_engine_recheck_desc: Chafata Hlola kabusha nobe ucale kabusha kusetha kute ulande iphakheji.
linux_usb_rules_active_desc: MediaTek imitsetfo lesebentako (/ njll / udev / imitsetfo.d /). Kuvunyelwe kufinyelela kudeskithophu.
linux_usb_grant_desc: Niketa timvume kanye kute luhlelo lokusebenta lukhone kukhulumisana nedivayisi yakho.
linux_perms_ok_msg: Imvume ye-USB & imitsetfo ye-udev ifakwe ngemphumelelo. Tinsita letilungisiwe.
donate_rely_on_you: Sisite ngetindleko tetfu tekusebenta, nikela namuhla.
flash_sp_gui_tooltip: Vula i-GUI yeLithuluzi Lekukhanya Le-MediaTek SP
status_app_reset_defaults: I-app isethwe kabusha ngalokuphelele, i-cache yekulandza isuswa, futsi sikhumbuto sebhethri sibuyiselwe emuva.
log_app_reset_defaults: Kuhleleka kwe-app kusetjentiswe kabusha ngalokuphelele, i-cache yekulandza isuswa, futsi sikhumbuto sebhethri sibuyiselwe (R).
flash_watch_waiting: Ngilindzele umdlali wakho kutsi acale kabusha...
flash_watch_waiting_hint: Gcina ixhunyiwe, iRockbox iyacala futsi tindikimba tayo titawungetwa ngekuzenzakalela.
flash_watch_timeout_hint: Hlola kutsi ixhunyiwe futsi ivuliwe. Uma kuhlala kumnyama, cindezela ipini emgodzini wekusetha kabusha bese ubamba inkinobho lesemkhatsini (Y1) noma inkinobho yamandla (labanye badlali) kute uyicale kabusha. Uma solo ngeke kuqale, firmware akazange atsatse, faka lomunye.
action_flash_complete: Kuphelile kwe-Flash! Khupha i-USB bese ucala kabusha.
action_recover_powercycle: Amandla-umjikeleto umdlali (bamba amandla ~ 10s), bese uyawuxhuma kabusha - uzama kabusha...
action_wait_mtk: Kulindzelwe idivayisi ye-MTK... Cisha idivayisi bese uxhuma i-USB.
action_da_stall: Idivayisi yekile kuphendvula ngesikhatsi ilungiselela i-ejenti yekulandza. Licishe ngalokuphelele, uphindze uxhumeke, bese uyazama kabusha.
action_detected_brom: Idivayisi itfolakele (imodi ye-BROM) - kulungisa i-ejenti yekulandza...
action_detected_preloader: Idivayisi itfolakele (imodi yekulayisha) - kulungisa i-ejenti yekulandza...
action_da_wait_back: Umdlali wayekela kuphendvula ngesikhatsi acala i-ejenti yekulandza. Ngilindze kutsi ibuye...
log_sparse_fmt: Kutfolakele sitfombe se-Android lesingakacaci se {part}, sigucula enchubeni...
err_code_partition_table_invalid: Kucinisekisa lithebula lekuhlukanisa kwehlulekile ngemuva kwekubhala
err_sp_wrong_model: Uxhume imodeli lengakalungi yemdlali. Chafata inkinobho letsi × kute ukhansele lokufaka, bese ukhetsa isoftware yemdlali lowuxhumile.
err_sp_timeout: Leli thuluzi alizange limbone lomdlali. Gcina icishiwe futsi ungayifaki, bese uxhuma intsambo ye-USB uma ucelwa.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Umdlali unika amandla kusenesikhatsi kakhulu. Yicishe ngalokuphelele, bese uyayixhuma futsi.
err_sp_download_fail: Kwaphazamiseka kubhala. Hlola intsambo ye-USB kanye ne-port kanye nekushaja kwebhethri, bese uyazama futsi.
err_sp_da_init_sync: I-ejenti yekulandza ayikwatanga kucala. Zama lenye indlela ye-flash.
err_sp_brom_da_fail: I-ejenti yekulandza ayikwazanga kutfunyelwa kumdlali. Licishe bese uyaphindze uxhumeke.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Umdlali wala i-ejenti yekulandza (liphutsa 6104). Sebentisa i-Agent yekulandza lehlanganiswe ne-SP Flash Tool, bese uhlola kutsi i-firmware iyahambisana yini nalomdlali.
err_sp_com_port: Leli thuluzi alizange likhone kuvula itheku layo le-serial. Vala lamanye emathuluzi lakhanyako bese uphindze uxhume.
err_com_port_reboot_suggestion: Ichweba le-USB COM alizange livulwe (liphutsa 1013). Kucala kabusha ngcondvomshini wakho kutawukhipha itheku lelikhiyiwe. Sicela uvule kabusha ngcondvomshini wakho bese uyazama futsi.
err_sp_enable_dram: Leli thuluzi alizange liqale inkumbulo yemdlali. Sebentisa iphakheji leyakhelwe le modeli ngqo.
err_sp_storage_read: Leli thuluzi alizange likwati kufundza sitoreji semdlali. Hlola kutsi kuxhumana; kungenteka kutsi le divayisi inephutsa le-hardware.
err_attempt_timeout: Lithuluzi lelikhanyako alizange likhombise inchubekelembili kungakapheli {seconds} imizuzwane, ngako-ke lomzamo wamiswa.
err_connection_failed_desc: Akazange akhone kusungula uxhumano ezizinzile umdlali. Ciniseka kutsi idivayisi icishiwe (sebentisa i-pin kute ucindetele inkinobho yekusetha kabusha nangabe kudzingeka), khipha i-USB, bese uyaphindze uxhumeke nawucelwa.
err_flash_write_failed_desc: Kukhanya kwaphazamiseka noma umsebenti wekubhala wehlulekile. Hlola kutsi intsambo ye-USB ixhunywe kahle yini futsi ibhethri inemandla lanele, bese uyazama futsi.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Lithuluzi lelikhanyako likhombise umugca lofanako ngemizuzwana yekugcina {seconds} futsi alibonakali liyachubeka nekubhala i-firmware. Kungenteka kutsi i-flash yehlulekile. Uma ngabe loku bekungukugcina kwemizamo lemibili ngendlela ngayinye eluhlelweni lolungawela emuva emkhatsini wabo, noma uma ngabe i-MTKClient kuphela letfolakala kulomshini, calisa kabusha ikhompyutha bese uyazama futsi.
err_only_mtkclient_desc: I-MTKClient kuphela letfolakalako kulokufakwa. Kungenteka kutsi i-flash yehlulekile. Ucelwa kutsi uvule kabusha ikhompyutha bese uyazama futsi.
err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Lekhompyutha ingaphindze ifake kusetjentiswa SP Flash Tool. Uma ungakhona, shintjela ku-SP Flash Tool bese uyazama futsi.
prompt_restart_and_quit_desc: Kungenteka kutsi i-flash yehlulekile. Sicela ufundze lomlayeto longenhla bese ucala kabusha ngcondvomshini ngaphambi kwekutsi uphindze uzame. Uma uchafata OK, le-app itawuyekela kute ukhone kucala kabusha.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Iphakheji ye-firmware ayikho lifayela lekusakata noma emafayela etitfombe ladzingekako. Ucelwa kutsi uphindze ulandze leliphakheji nobe ukhetse lifayela le-firmware leliphelele.
err_auth_file_unusable_desc: Ifayela lekucinisekisa lolikhetsile alikho, alinalutfo noma alikhoni kubhalwa. Khetsa lifayela lelisebentako, nobe ulisuse ku- Settings, bese uphindze ukhanyise.
err_tool_unavailable_desc: Lithuluzi lelikhanyako noma bashayeli beluhlelo labadzingekako abazange bakhone kucala. Ucelwa kutsi uhlole timvume teluhlelo, kusetha kwemshayeli, noma ufake kabusha luhlelo lokusebenta.
err_driver_missing_desc: Leliphutsa lingenteka uma umshayeli we-MediaTek USB angafakwa. Chafata Layisha Bashayeli kute ufake umshayeli we-MediaTek USB, ucale kabusha ngcondvomshini wakho, bese uyazama futsi.
err_cache_file_missing_desc: Ifayela le-firmware lefakwe ku-cache alikho. Khetsa Khetsa I-Software kute wakhe kabusha emafayela lakhishiwe nobe uphindze ulande umgcinimafa we-firmware. Lena yinkinga yefayela lendzawo, hhayi inkinga yekuxhumana kwe-USB.
sel_cache_retry_tooltip: Buyela ku Khetsa I-Software kute wakhe kabusha nobe ulandze iphakheji ye-firmware.
sel_cache_retry_select_release: Khetsa kukhishwa kwe-firmware kute uphindze ulandze.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Kwenteke liphutsa lelingakalindzeleki ngesikhatsi sekufakwa ({detail}). Cisha umdlali ngalokuphelele, phindze uxhumeke uma ucelwa, bese uyazama futsi.
flash_method_confirm: Indlela yekufaka ishintjwe yaba ngu {method}. Cinisekisa kutsi umdlali ukhishiwe futsi ucishiwe, bese uchafata Lokulandzelako.
flash_failover_note: {method} akazange atfole kufakwa kucala. Ngemuva kwekutsi umdlali acishiwe futsi akhishwe, {other} utawusetjentiswa esikhundleni saloko.
themepack_card_desc: Kufaka ekhatsi tingcikitsi letinhle temmango, tindzawo letine-resolution lesetulu, kanye nemafonti lakhiwe ngco emibukisweni ye-360p.
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Vula umdlali wakho ngekubamba inkinobho Power.
2. Uma iRockbox iqala, faka intsambo ye-USB kukhompyutha yakho.
3. Uma kucelwa esikrinini semdlali, cinisekisa imodi ye-USB Storage ngako-ke idivayisi ivela njengedrayivu.
themepack_step2_title: Sinyatselo 2: Khetsa Noma nguyiphi Ifolda ku-Player .
themepack_step2_desc: Ngenca yekutsi tinhlelo tekusebenta (njenge-macOS) tifihla ema-dotfile (njenge-.rockbox) ngekujwayelekile, ungakhetsa NOMA NGABE NGUYIPHI ifolda nobe umsuka we-drive kumdlali wakho. Sitawutfola ngekuzenzakalela nobe sikudale umkhombandlela we-.rockbox.
themepack_complete: Iphakheji yengcikitsi ifakwe ngemphumelelo! Manje ungakhipha umdlali wakho ngendlela lephephile bese ukhetsa ingcikitsi ku-Rockbox (Tilungiselelo > Tilungiselelo Tengcikitsi).
themepack_err_not_found: Ayikhoni kutfola noma kucala umkhombandlela we-.rockbox ku-drive lekhetsiwe. Sicela ucinisekise kutsi ukhetse ifolda kumdlali wakho.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Sinyatselo 1: Qala kabusha umdlali bese uxhuma kabusha
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Khupha intsambo ye-USB.
2. Amandla umdlali emuva on bese uvumela ibhuthi ku Rockbox.
3. Uma Rockbox seyisebenta, phindze uxhume intsambo ye-USB, bese ucindezela Chubeka.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: Lolu hlelo lokusebenza lubuka uxhumano lwe-ADB (kuze kube yimizuzwana engu-30). Uma kutfolakala idivayisi, tindikimba tidluliselwa bese umdlali uyacala kabusha ngekuzenzakalela. Ngaphandle kwaloko, yeqa phambili ku-USB Mode Yesitoreji.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Kulindzelwe idivayisi ye-ADB... (kuze kube yimizuzwana lengu-30)
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Kute idivayisi ye-ADB letfolakele kungakapheli imizuzwane lengu-30; kuchubeka nge Modi Yekugcina i-USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Kute i-ADB kanambambili letfolakala ku-app; kuchubeka nge Modi Yekugcina i-USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Kudluliselwa kwe-ADB kwehlulekile; kubuyela emuva ku-USB Mode yeSitoreji
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Niketa emandla USB Storage Mode kumdlali ngakho kuvela njengedrayivu.
2. Khetsa NOMA NGABE NGUYIPHI ifolda kumdlali longentasi (.rockbox, Umculo, Ingcikitsi, noma umsuka wekushayela, ifolda lefihlekile ye-.rockbox itfolakala ngekuzenzakalela).
3. Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luhlanganisa tindikimba te-360p kanye nemafonti ku, kubhala ngetulu kwemafayela laneligama lelifanako.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Manje ungaphepha unciphise umdlali bese ukhetsa ingcikitsi ku-Rockbox (Tilungiselelo> Tilungiselelo Tengcikitsi).
rockbox_cleanup_failed_note: I-software yakho lensha ifakiwe, kepha ifolda lendzala ye-.rockbox ayikwatanga kususwa. Cisha ifolda ye-.rockbox kumdlali ngesandla uma ufuna sicalo lesihlantekile.
rockbox_stage_disconnect_extra: Umdlali longetulu kwamunye uxhunyiwe. Ncamula letinye bese ushiya kuphela leyo lefakwako.
rockbox_stage_pushing: Umdlali utfolakele. Kubeka tingcikitsi temmango kanye nemafonti...
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Bamba inkinobho lesemkhatsini kute uvule i-Y1 yakho, phindze uxhume i-USB, bese ukhetsa i-USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Bamba inkinobho yemandla kute uvule umdlali wakho, phindze uxhume i-USB, bese ukhetsa i-USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_step1_disconnect_power_on: Sicela unciphe bese uvula {model} yakho, bese ucindetela Lokulandzelako
rockbox_step1_power_on_button: Khupha i-USB, ubamba i-{button} kute uvule {model} yakho, bese ucindetela Lokulandzelako.
rockbox_step_standalone_power_on_usb: Namatsisela intsambo ye-USB ku {model} yakho, bese ucindezela Lokulandzelako.
rockbox_step_select_rockbox_folder: Ucelwa kutsi ukhetse umdlali yena noma ifolda ye .rockbox .
rockbox_select_software_hint: Khetsa umdlali wakho kanye nesofthiwe lengetulu, nobe uyixhume nge-USB kute uyibone ngekuzenzakalela.
completion_installed_get_themes_non_dona: Sifake {software} ku {model} yakho. Unga {get_themes} ngekutsi uchafate inkinobho letsi {palette}.
completion_installed_guide_and_themes_no: Sifake {software} ku {model} yakho. Chafata {globe} kuya ku {view_guide}, nobe {get_themes} ngekutsi uchafate inkinobho {palette}.

completion_installed_guide_and_themes_do: Landzela tinyatselo tekusetha kuya ku {view_guide}, na {get_themes} ku {model} yakho ngezansi.
completion_themes_failed_get_themes_non_: Sifake {software} ku {model} yakho, kepha tingcikitsi atikwatanga kukopishwa ngekuzenzakalela. Unga {get_themes} ngekutsi uchafate inkinobho letsi {palette}.
completion_themes_failed_get_themes_dona: Tingcikitsi betingakhoni kukopishwa ngekuzenzakalela. Unga {get_themes} ngesandla usebentisa lenkinobho lengentansi.
completion_240p_manual_heading: {software} ku {model} isekela tingcikitsi te-iPod Classic letingu-240p
completion_240p_manual_body: Awudzingi iphakheji yetingcikitsi te-360p — chafata {get_themes} kute uphenye tingcikitsi letihambisanako te-240p.
settings_get_240p_themes_link: Tfola 240p Y1 / Y2 / Tihloko Tekucala Te-iPod
settings_save_360p_themes_zip_saved: Tihloko letigcinwe te-360p ZIP kuya ku {path}
rockbox_reconnect_after_disconnect: Kulahlekile kuxhumana kwe-USB. Qala kabusha {model} yakho bese uphindze uxhume intsambo ye-USB kute uchubeke.
rockbox_paperclip_restart_tip: Lusito: Sebentisa i-paperclip emgodzini we-pinhole wekusetha kabusha kute usheshe ucime amandla bese ucala kabusha {model} yakho.
rockbox_step2_connect_usb_storage: Ucelwa kutsi uxhume {model} yakho ngemodi yekudlulisa ye-USB
rockbox_step_usb_storage_mode: Sicela unikete emandla imodi yekugcina i-USB kudivayisi yakho bese uchafata Lokulandzelako
rockbox_step_usb_storage_folder: Sicela unikete emandla imodi yekugcina i-USB ku {model} yakho, bese ukhetsa idrayivu levelako .
rockbox_step_select_player_folder: Sicela ukhetse umdlali yena noma lenye yemafolda lakuwo .
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_y1: Ncamula i-USB bese ucindezela i-Y1 yakho, bese ucindezela Next.
rockbox_power_on_prompt_sp_other: Khupha i-USB bese ufaka emandla ku {model} yakho, bese ucindezela Lokulandzelako.
rockbox_manual_guide:
1. Khetsa 'Imodi Yesitoreji se-USB' kumdlali wakho.
2. Chafata 'Dlulisa Ifolda...' kukhetsa umdlali wakho bese ufaka tindikimba.
rockbox_site_themes_note: Lokwakha kweRockbox kusebentisa tindikimba letingu-240 × 320, letingahlanganiswa. Tfola tindikimba tamahhala temdlali wakho kusuka kusayithi yetingcikitsi te-Rockbox:
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: Uma {model} yakho ingavuli, nciphisa i-USB, ubambe inkinobho yemandla ema-10s kute usethe kabusha, bese uvula amandla. Nobe ubuyisele isoftware yekucala.
err_storage_full_desc: Ikhompyutha yakho seyiphelelwe sikhala sekugcina tintfo. Sicela ukhulule sikhala se-disk ku-drive yakho bese uyazama futsi.
legacy_cleanup_desc: Inguqulo lendzala ye-Updater isekhona kulekhompyutha futsi itsatsa sikhala se-disk. Kuyikhipha kukhulula leso sikhala.
legacy_cleanup_remove_app_cb: Susa luhlelo lwe-Innioasis Updater loludzala kanye nemafolda lasekelako
legacy_cleanup_keep_platform_tools_cb: Gcina Emathulusi Epulatifomu Ye-Android (ADB / FastBoot) afakiwe
legacy_cleanup_platform_tools_hint: Uma ungasebentisi i-ADB noma i-Fastboot ngaphandle kwe-Updater, susa kuhlola kute ukhiphe bese uphindze ufune sitoreji lesengetiwe.
legacy_cleanup_done_msg: Kuhlantwe ngemphumelelo kufakwa kwelifa kanye nesikhala sediski lesibuyiselwe emuva.
legacy_cleanup_card_desc: Inguqulo lendzala ye-Updater isekhona kulekhompyutha. Kuyikhipha kukhulula sikhala sediski.
legacy_cleanup_confirm_body: Loku kususa ngalokuphelele i-app lendzala, i-firmware lelandvwe, kanye nemafayela lasele.
legacy_cleanup_tools_body: Susa Emathulusi Epulatifomu Ye-Android (ADB / Fastboot) kanye? Khetsa Gcina uma usebentisa i-ADB.
settings_arm64_driver_note: ARM64 Kusekelwa kweWindows akukahlolwa. Kuma-laptops e-Snapdragon kanye ne-RTX Spark, i-Zadig ingasetjentiswa ngekuphocelelwa kweSiginesha Yemshayeli lekhubatekile kufaka i-WinUSB noma i-libusb yedivayisi ye-MT6227 Preloader kuMphatsi Wetintfo. Bona umhlahlandlela wemshayeli we-ARM64 ngetinyatselo.
